interaction_protocols.question: Does target Energy restoration occur before or after DMG-buff application?
preconditions: Use a release build with a version recorded.
Use a legal ally target and a known Tingyun Ultimate trace level.
Configure an observable trigger that distinguishes Energy restoration from buff application without changing either effect.
procedure: Record the complete pre-cast state and trigger subscriptions.
Cast Tingyun Ultimate as an interrupt on the selected ally.
Capture ordered effect and trigger events from the same action boundary.
Repeat until the ordering observation is reproducible.
required_observations: Version, build, target, trace level, and recording protocol.

interaction_protocols.question: Does the end of an ally's already-active normal turn consume the first count of a two-turn Tingyun Ultimate DMG buff?
preconditions: Use a release build with a version recorded.
Begin the selected ally's normal turn before casting the Ultimate interrupt.
Use a visible or logged buff-duration indicator and avoid extra-turn effects.
procedure: Record the selected ally's active normal-turn state.
Cast Tingyun Ultimate during that normal turn.
Record buff duration immediately after application and after the current turn ends.
Record the next two selected-ally normal-turn boundaries and exact expiration point.
Repeat with the Ultimate cast outside the ally's active turn as a control.
required_observations: Duration after the already-active turn ends.
Exact expiration boundary in both test and control runs.
Version, build, target, trace level, and recording protocol.
